# Plan

Existing equivalents are reused, not duplicated: the design is in `docs/design/phase3-plan.md`; the protocol is `bench/protocols/2026-10-28-phase2.md`; the register is `docs/limits.md`.

## Design: detector v2, "endpoint-source join" (fixes register row 158)

v1 matches a probe to an impacted route by the decorator's own path text (`GET /{slug}`), but OpenAPI paths are full (`/api/recipes/{slug}`), and Mealie joins prefixes across files and uses class-based controllers; a regex join would be fragile. v2 asks the running app instead:

1. `lib/behavior.js`: `surfacesOf` also returns the impacted code files (changed code + dependents from the import graph); `diff` writes them to `files.json` and passes `--files` to `generate`; coverage counts a probe as reaching an impacted surface when it was generated by the file join.
2. `scripts/behavior/probe_runner.py`: `generate_http` walks `app.routes`, takes each `APIRoute`'s endpoint source file (unwrapped, relative to the worktree) and keeps the operations whose endpoint lives in an impacted file, in addition to v1's path match; a route path that matches no OpenAPI operation is reported as a note, not silently dropped.
3. v1 stays reproducible from the frozen worktree at `4fbb80e`; on HEAD the pin test is re-targeted to the immutable git blobs (same strength, documented).
